purpose: Define the governed operating model for an agentic AI development team that can execute Multiversal work continuously, safely, and with verifiable repository evidence.

authorityModel.agentAuthority: execute all reversible, policy-compliant, non-scope-changing work without repeated approval
mandatoryOwnerGates: new paid service or material recurring cost
conflicting canonical requirements that cannot be reconciled

teamRoles.accountability: Own workstream sequencing, task decomposition, evidence collection, and merge readiness.
Preserve architecture, governance, identifiers, schemas, and repository structure.
Implement bounded changes from verified requirements with minimal scope and tests.
Independently validate requirements, tests, regression risk, provenance, and completion claims.
mustNot: reuse implementer conclusions without fresh evidence

teamRoles.accountability: Apply Multiversal game-system and content-domain constraints without altering source truth.
Enforce branch, PR, CI, migration, rollback, artifact, and handoff requirements.

failurePolicy.ciFailure: inspect logs, fix root cause, rerun, and continue automatically
failurePolicy.permissionFailure: stop and report exact failed operation and missing permission
failurePolicy.ambiguousRequirement: derive recommendation from canonical evidence; use owner-delegated recommendation unless a mandatory owner gate applies
failurePolicy.unsafeOrIrreversible: stop before mutation and request owner decision
failurePolicy.partialCompletion: never label complete; record exact completed and remaining gates

handoffMinimum: active workstream and next verified item
